# aether_registry_robot_accounts (Data Source)

Every robot account of the organization's registry, including the default robot created when the registry was enabled. Secrets are never listed: the API returns a robot's secret only when it is created.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `robot_accounts` (Attributes List) The robot accounts, in the API's order (by id). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--robot_accounts))

<a id="nestedatt--robot_accounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `robot_accounts`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `harbor_id` (Number) Registry-side robot id; null when the platform holds none.
- `harbor_username` (String) The `docker login` username (`robot$<project>+<name>`); null when the platform holds none.
- `id` (String) Robot account UUID.
- `name` (String) Robot name.
- `permissions` (Set of String) Subset of `push`, `pull`, `delete`.
- `updated_at` (String) Last write time (RFC 3339).
